properties.name: toggly
properties.description: Connect Azure Pipelines to the Toggly management API with OAuth2 client credentials.

url.helpText: Base URL for the Toggly API. Default: https://app.toggly.io/api

inputDescriptors.name: Authority URL
inputDescriptors.description: OAuth2 authority for client-credentials token requests. Default: https://auth.toggly.io

inputDescriptors.name: Client ID
inputDescriptors.description: OAuth2 Client ID from Toggly Team Settings → API Credentials

inputDescriptors.name: Client Secret
inputDescriptors.description: OAuth2 Client Secret from Toggly Team Settings → API Credentials

properties.helpMarkDown: Create OAuth2 client credentials in [Toggly](https://app.toggly.io) under Team Settings → API Credentials. Use Client ID and Client Secret here. Docs: [Azure DevOps integration](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops).
